eye_color.notes: Described explicitly as 'ice-blue' in dialogue. Visible in close-up.

hair_color.notes: Short bob cut. Dyes are never mentioned.

jacket.notes: Her signature look. Only removed in ep 3 bath scene.

abilities.name: Echo Sight
abilities.description: Can replay past events as visual echoes

relationships.notes: They worked together at the Bureau before the incident.

events.title: The Bureau Incident
events.summary: Aria witnesses the explosion at the Bureau that kills Director Holt. She is the only survivor.

events.title: Kael and Aria reunion
events.summary: Aria encounters Kael for the first time since the Bureau Incident. Kael accuses her of being responsible.

events.title: Aria uses Echo Sight in the Archive
events.summary: Aria activates Echo Sight inside the Old Archive building. The echo she replays shows Director Holt alive one hour before the explosion.

events.title: The Signal
events.summary: A coded signal identical to the pre-incident frequency is detected. Aria and Kael form a temporary truce to investigate.

locations.name: Nexus City
locations.notes: Futuristic urban setting. Perpetually foggy lower districts.
